room_rent.note: Default room rent is up to 1% of Coverage Amount per day. Optional Benefit 7 (Room Rent Modification) can change this to a higher % or no sub-limit as specified in Certificate of Insurance.

icu.note: ICU charges limited to 2% of Coverage Amount per day. Under Optional Benefit 7, ICU is twice the non-ICU % opted.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the base policy wording.

sub_limits.display: Room rent & ICU capped; other benefits per Certificate of Insurance
sub_limits.note: Room rent capped at 1% of SI/day and ICU at 2% of SI/day by default. Maternity, reinstatement, and other benefits have coverage amounts per Certificate of Insurance. No explicit disease-wise sub-limits stated beyond room/ICU.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible for Base Benefit 1. Daily Cash Allowance (Optional Benefit 6) has a deductible in days before payment.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses under Base Benefit 1. Waivable via Optional Benefit 2.

ped_waiting.note: The policy does not explicitly state a PED waiting period. PED definition references 36 months prior to commencement but no specific waiting period for PED coverage is stated in the wording.

specific_disease_waiting.note: No specific named-disease waiting period list is provided in the wording beyond the standard 30-day initial waiting period.

maternity.note: Maternity Expenses covered under Base Benefit 1 (Benefit 3.1.4) with 9-month waiting period. Covers normal delivery, C-section, miscarriage. Limited to first two living children. Coverage up to age 45. Waiting period waivable via Optional Benefit 3.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative bonus or no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording.

restoration.note: Coverage Amount reinstated once per Cover Year after exhaustion. Reinstated amount cannot be used for the same illness/injury for which a claim was already admitted. Unutilized reinstated amount cannot be carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalization expenses covered for 1 day immediately prior to admission. Extendable via Optional Benefit 4 (Modification of Pre & Post Hospitalization Medical Expenses).

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalization expenses covered for 5 days after discharge. Extendable via Optional Benefit 4.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered only for procedures listed in Annexure-I of the policy.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalization is defined but not listed as a covered benefit under any Base or Optional Benefit.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatments covered under Base Benefit 1 (Benefit 3.1.6) via cashless or reimbursement up to Coverage Amount, subject to in-patient claim admissibility.

organ_donor.note: Donor treatment expenses including surgery to remove organs from donor are explicitly excluded (Clause 4.2.2.xvii).

ambulance.note: Ambulance is listed under Annexure II as a non-medical excluded item (List I, item 67). No ambulance cover benefit is mentioned.

modern_treatments.note: Advanced technology methods (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, etc.) covered under In-patient Care and Day Care Treatment. Expenses on advance technology methods other than those listed are excluded.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) are explicitly excluded per Annexure II. No rider available for consumables cover.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment taken entirely within India. Treatment received outside India is explicitly excluded (Clause 4.2.2.xx).

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months), no look-back applied. Claims not contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments during policy period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document. Not applicable at renewal.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, organ donor expenses, domiciliary hospitalisation, treatment outside India, ambulance, consumables, external congenital anomalies

optional_riders.display: Accidental Hospitalisation, Waiver of Initial Waiting Period, Waiver of Maternity Waiting Period, Modified Pre/Post-Hosp, Modified Maternity Cover, Daily Cash Allowance, Room Rent Modification
